documents.title: refund-policy.txt
documents.text: First-purchase refunds: A customer may request a full refund within 30 calendar days of their first paid purchase. Submit the order number and account email to support. Renewals and add-on usage are not covered by this introductory refund policy. Approved refunds return to the original payment method within five to ten business days.

documents.title: cancel-subscription.txt
documents.text: To stop future subscription renewals, open Settings, Billing, Manage subscription, then Cancel renewal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid billing period. The workspace stays accessible until that date. Cancellation does not automatically issue a refund or delete stored documents.

documents.title: password-recovery.txt
documents.text: If you forget your password, select Forgot password on the sign-in screen and enter the account email. A reset link is valid for 20 minutes and can be used once. Check junk mail if the email does not arrive. For accounts without access to their mailbox, contact support for identity verification. Staff must never request a customer's password.

documents.title: lost-authenticator.txt
documents.text: When a phone containing the authenticator is lost, sign in with an unused recovery code saved during two-factor setup. Each recovery code works once. If all codes are lost, contact the security support team for account ownership verification. Staff cannot disable two-factor authentication based only on an email request.

documents.title: billing-disputes.txt
documents.text: Report an incorrect invoice or a duplicate settled card charge to billing support. Include invoice identifiers, dates, amounts, and only the last four card digits. A pending bank authorization is not a settled payment and usually expires within seven business days. Never send full card numbers or card security codes.

documents.title: invoice-download.txt
documents.text: Workspace owners and administrators can download invoices from Billing, Invoice history. Choose a billing month and select Download PDF. Agents cannot access invoice history. Update the billing address before the next renewal to change future invoices; already issued tax documents require assistance from billing support.

documents.title: upload-troubleshooting.txt
documents.text: Document uploads accept PDF, TXT, and Markdown up to 2 MiB per file. Remove PDF password protection before uploading. A scanned PDF with no text layer cannot be searched until optical character recognition has been performed elsewhere. An upload that contains only blank text must be replaced with a readable file.

documents.title: connection-troubleshooting.txt
documents.text: If the application repeatedly displays Connection unavailable, verify your internet connection and try reloading the page. Check the service status page for an incident. If the network works but the problem persists, record the time and request identifier and contact technical support. Do not include passwords or session cookies in screenshots.

documents.title: data-export.txt
documents.text: An owner can export workspace tickets from Settings, Data export. The export is a CSV containing ticket identifiers, titles, categories, and status. Internal notes and attachments are excluded. Large exports may take several minutes. Store the downloaded file securely because it can contain confidential support information.

documents.title: workspace-roles.txt
documents.text: Owners control workspace settings and membership. Administrators can manage support agents and viewers but cannot remove an owner. Support agents handle assigned tickets and knowledge documents. Viewers can read ticket information and document metadata but cannot read private document contents or run semantic search. At least one owner must remain.

documents.title: support-hours.txt
documents.text: Standard customer support operates Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC, excluding published holidays. Ordinary questions receive an initial response within two business days. Critical security incidents should use the security report channel, which is monitored continuously. These are response targets, not guaranteed resolution times.

documents.title: report-security.txt
documents.text: Suspected account compromise or a vulnerability should be reported through the dedicated security form. Include a concise description and safe reproduction steps. Do not attach live credentials, private customer records, or exploit payloads. For active account compromise, revoke active sessions and rotate the password from a trusted device.

documents.title: change-plan.txt
documents.text: Workspace owners can change a subscription tier in Billing, Plans. Upgrades apply immediately with a prorated charge for the remainder of the billing period. Downgrades apply at the next renewal. Review document and member limits before downgrading. Changing a plan does not automatically remove existing workspace members.

documents.title: delete-workspace.txt
documents.text: Only a workspace owner can request permanent workspace deletion. Export necessary records first. Deletion removes tickets, notes, documents, and searchable passages after the confirmation period. This operation cannot be reversed after completion. Cancelling the subscription alone does not delete the workspace or its data.
